name: Drawer
summary: Side-anchored panel that slides over the page. Use for long-form detail views, multi-step forms, and side editors — the affordance is 'I'm peeking at something tied to this page'. Distinct from Dialog (modal interrupt) and Sheet (bottom-anchored mobile primitive).

side.description: Side it slides in from. right is the desktop default for detail views; left for sidebar editors; top/bottom for full-width banners-as-panels.

size.description: side='right|left': sm=400 / md=520 / lg=720 / full=100vw min 90vw. side='top|bottom': sm=240 / md=360 / lg=520 / full=100vh.

modal.description: When true (default), focus is trapped + rest of page is inert + scrim painted. When false, the drawer behaves as a non-modal inspector that lets the user keep interacting with the page behind.

dismissible.description: When true, Escape + outside-click dismiss + a close X in the header. False locks the drawer until the consumer toggles open via a primary action (rare; use for required-step flows).

footer.description: Sticky footer slot. Hosts primary + secondary actions for the drawer task.

wcag: 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap (intentional, with visible exit)
rules: Focus trap when modal=true; first focusable receives focus on open.
Returns focus to the trigger on close.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: drop the slide-in to a fade; keep the duration.
When non-modal: page remains interactive but the drawer's content is announced once via aria-live='polite'.

do: Use Drawer for inspecting a row in detail without losing the table context.
Use Drawer for multi-step forms that need width.
Use side='right' for desktop detail views; side='bottom' on mobile for the same task (paired with Sheet semantics).
Pin a sticky footer with primary + secondary actions.
Set non-modal=false (default modal) for editing flows; modal=false only for read-only inspectors.
dont: Don't use Drawer for short-form confirmations — Dialog.
Don't put a Drawer trigger inside a Drawer (nested drawers are a smell).
Don't leave the Drawer open across page navigations — close on route change.

changelog.note: Initial Drawer contract. Four sides, four sizes. Modal + non-modal. Sticky footer slot.
